ModMetaData.name: Chrono Save
ModMetaData.author: Zei33
ModMetaData.description:
Chrono Save saves your colony on a real-time schedule rather than an in-game one, so the gap between saves is the same whether you are paused, playing at speed three, or sitting through a long raid.
CORE FEATURES - Automatic saves every 5 minutes of real time (configurable) - Works independently of vanilla autosaves - no interference - Continues saving even when game is paused or at different speeds - Rotating save system prevents save file buildup - No Harmony patches and no dependencies
FUNCTIONALITY - Uses real-world time tracking instead of in-game time - Creates saves named after your colony once you name it, with rotating numbers - Saves are standard RimWorld saves - fully compatible with all features - Each chronosave is checked after it is written, and you are told if one looks incomplete - Minimal performance impact with efficient time tracking
SAVE MANAGEMENT - Default: 10 rotating chronosaves per colony - Reuses the oldest slot when the limit is reached - Each named colony keeps its own set, so two colonies never overwrite each other - Configurable save count (1-25 saves) - Independent save files won't conflict with manual or auto saves
FLEXIBLE CONFIGURATION - Save interval: Adjustable from 1 to 60 minutes - Save count: Choose how many chronosaves to maintain - Enable/disable toggle: Turn the system on or off as needed - Access settings through Options, then mod options, then Chrono Save
PAUSE-FRIENDLY DESIGN - Saves continue even when game is paused - Works at all game speeds (1x, 2x, 3x) - Perfect for long planning sessions or AFK periods - Holds off while you are picking a target, choosing a shuttle destination, planning a caravan route or reading a dialog, then saves as soon as you are done
COMMITMENT MODE - No chronosaves are written while a Commitment mode colony is loaded - That mode is built around a single save file, and every extra copy is a way to roll back - There is no setting to change this
